lessons_control.note: pre_lessons is each hunter's own sum before it read researcher_us/LESSONS.md. edge_resolve.py ranks it against the same realised move as the key, which is the only thing that can tell the guidance file apart from a habit.

language_control.note: pre_local is each hunter's own sum after the ENGLISH pass and before the local pass. eu_resolve.py ranks it against the same realised move as the key, per market, and does not pool the UK (where the second pass varies source locality) with Germany and France (where it varies language).

note: Ranked on impact_sum: the hunters' signed per-finding sizes, added up, in points of spot. No call and no threshold -- cut wherever you like afterwards, which is what keeps the ranking question answerable at every k. `conviction` (abs of the key) is where the direction skill lives: over all events the sign is a coin flip, above the median conviction it is 74%. conviction_floor is a floor on emphasis in the note, never a filter on this file. Everything under `diagnostics` was measured as neutral or subtractive and decides nothing -- see researcher_us/EDGE_ANALYSIS.md.

hunter_view.positioning_check: The AMF register read for this run (as of 2026-09-16) and does NOT name Quadient, so its disclosed net short is 0.0 at the 0.5% threshold -- a real zero at that threshold, not a measurement: `anchor_covered` is false on this baseline and there is no positioning anchor. What the register does not carry, and the AMF's threshold-crossing file does: Janus Henderson Investors UK Limited crossed ABOVE 5% of capital and voting rights on 23 July 2026 and holds 1,741,870 shares, 5.05%. AMF declaration 226C1172 of 30 July 2026.
hunter_view.baseline_tension: Neutral to mildly with the lean: the baseline's priced_lean_pct is -0.09, which is the 20-day run-up alone because Quadient carries no disclosed short, so there is no positioning anchor to agree or disagree with; my +0.9 is not beating a lean, it is beating nothing.

findings.finding: The market has given back most of what it paid for the Lockers strategic review. Quadient rose +6.00% on 96,222 shares on 20 July, roughly three times its recent volume, the day it announced the review; it closed at EUR 12.52 on 16 September against EUR 12.00 on 17 July. So the review premium has decayed to about a third of the announcement move over two months, into a print that is scheduled to carry the review's outcome.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This is not a line the company reports; it is the setup. The two most recent prints both fell hard on guidance rather than on strategy -- -17.8% on the H1 2025 print of 25 September 2025 when FY guidance was cut on softer US mail, and about -15% on the FY 2025 print in March 2026.

findings.finding: Janus Henderson Investors UK Limited crossed above the 5% threshold of Quadient's capital and voting rights on 23 July 2026 -- three days after the Lockers review was announced -- and holds 1,741,870 shares, 5.05%, bought on the market on behalf of funds and clients it manages.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No directly comparable prior event for this name. Treated as a small positive because a 5% holder that built the position after the review was announced is a marginal buyer that is unlikely to sell into an ambiguous update, on a name where the disclosed short register is empty.

findings.finding: The one unambiguously good line at this print has already been released. On 24 August Quadient disclosed Q2 Digital bookings up more than 20% year on year like-for-like, with French bookings up more than tenfold including a multi-million-euro white-label deal, ahead of France's e-invoicing mandate; on 1 September it followed with a release on serving over 800,000 entities in the mandate's first phase. The stock paid for it -- +3.26%, +1.58%, +1.86% over the three sessions from 24 August -- and has since given that back too.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Quadient's last two prints were both decided by Mail and by guidance, not by Digital: the September 2025 fall was attributed to a softer US mail rebound and hardware placements down 17.5%.

outside_window.finding: Q3 2026 sales are scheduled for 1 December 2026, and any Lockers transaction announced on 23 September would not complete inside this stage's one-session window.

lessons_applied: NOT A CLEAN FREEZE, and this must not be pooled. This hunt was run by the orchestrating session rather than by an isolated `unpriced-hunter-fr` subagent, because this session cannot spawn subagents, and it had read researcher_europe/LESSONS.md before the hunt began. pre_lessons is therefore equal to the emitted set by construction and is not a measurement of what the file changed.

The rules that did bear on the work: the session was confirmed against the issuer's own calendar rather than the vendor's flag; the date was read out of the source for every dated fact; and the caveat reaches the number -- the sum is +0.9 on a name whose last two prints moved -17.8% and -15%, which is why the band is wide rather than the point estimate large.

hunter_view.bar: FY 2025/26: comparable net sales at the prior-year level and an EBITDA margin of 19-21% excluding the one-time licence effect, cut from 'around 3% growth' on 12 February 2026 and confirmed at 9M on 12 May 2026. https://www.kws.com/corp/en/media-press/news/financial-results-for-the-first-nine-months-of-2025-2026-kws-remains-on-track-despite-a-challenging-agricultural-environment/
hunter_view.positioning_check: The Bundesanzeiger Netto-Leerverkaufspositionen register read for this run (as of 2026-09-17, 283 disclosed positions) and does not name KWS SAAT, so its disclosed net short is 0.0 at the 0.5% public threshold. That is the truncation floor, not a measurement: `anchor_covered` is false on this baseline, there is no positioning anchor, and `short_change_pct_pts` is 0.0 for the same reason. Nothing here says whether anyone is short below 0.5%.
hunter_view.baseline_tension: It cuts WITH the lean, weakly. The baseline's priced_lean_pct is -0.219, which is the 20-day run-up alone (+4.37%) because there is no disclosed short, so my negative agrees with the only directional number in the baseline -- which is a reason to hold the size in, not to raise it. That is why -2.1 of findings is emitted as -1.5.

findings.finding: European sugarbeet area is contracting again into the 2027 campaign, and KWS's FY 2026/27 guidance has to be set against it. The EU internal sugar price has fallen more than 30% in a year, from EUR 767/t to EUR 529/t; German beet area fell 12.6% in 2026 to about 338,700 ha; Suedzucker has asked Bavarian growers to stop planting and is cutting contracted area by a similar order again for 2026 and 2027; and the new beet price model for the 2027/28 campaign sets a guaranteed base price well below prior years. Sugarbeet is KWS's highest-margin segment and the February 2026 guidance cut was caused by exactly this mechanism.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 12 February 2026 cut on the same line -- 'a greater reduction in global sugarbeet area than previously assumed' -- was absorbed rather than punished; the German wires headlined it 'KWS Saat leidet unter mauem Agrarmarkt - Gekappte Prognose kein Schock'. So this line has moved the stock before and did not move it far.

findings.finding: Russia is the second line pointing at the FY 2026/27 guide and it is the one KWS itself named in February. KWS has cited import restrictions and seed-localisation as an expected drag on the Russian business; Russia was EUR 140m of revenue and about 150 staff in FY 2023/24, against group revenue of EUR 1.68bn, and KWS said at the time that how much seed may be imported under the quota was open and that it did not rule out being left out of the quota altogether.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Named as one of the two reasons for the February 2026 revenue cut, alongside sugarbeet area, in a print the market treated as no shock.

The rules that bore on the work: read the date out of the source (it killed the Russian article as current evidence); the hunter's caveat has to reach the number (-2.1 of findings emitted as -1.5 because the sugarbeet line agrees with the lean and has already been absorbed once); and a finding that merely agrees with visible positioning is not a finding.
